# FDG7020

> DO ensure that exception messages are grammatically correct.

Framework Design Guidelines, 3rd edition, section 7.2.1 Error Message Design.

## How it is checked

- Check: judgment
- Automatic fix: no
- Severity: library warning, application warning, test warning
- Status: verified

Not machine-checkable: grammar is judgment. FDG7021 checks the final period.

## From the book

Top-level exception handlers can show the exception message to application end users.
